title: AWS deployment and support guide
summary: The installation timeline, what to include when contacting support, and the standard support response and resolution targets.
bodyMd:
This page sets out the installation timeline, what to include when you contact support, and the standard support response targets for a Personalisation Hub deployment.

Installation timeline

End to end, installation takes about 1.2 hours, most of it unattended.

StageDurationArticle
Stack creationAbout 4 minutesStep 1 — Deploy the platform through AWS Marketplace
Platform credentials (Master Admin account)About 2 minutesStep 2 — Run the Installation Wizard
Platform installationAbout 1 hour; the Master Admin receives an email when it completesStep 2 — Run the Installation Wizard
DNS set-upAbout 2 minutes, plus propagationStep 3 — Set up DNS after installation
Platform set-up and customisationAbout 5 minutesStep 4 — First login and platform set-up

Getting support

ItemDescription
ContactEmail support@personalisationhub.com
CoversDeployment errors, quota issues, configuration guidance and platform enquiries
IncludeYour AWS Account ID; the CloudFormation Stack ID (if available); the deployment Region; a description of the issue, with steps to reproduce where possible

Standard support targets

Response and resolution targets depend on incident severity. The service target is the proportion of incidents met within these times.

SeverityExampleInitial responseDiagnosticResolutionService target
P1 (Urgent)Platform API inaccessible4 business hours6 hours1 day90%
P2 (High)Campaign or playback issues4 business hours6 hours3 days90%
P3 (Low)Table loading speed4 business hours8 hours5 days90%
P4 (Minor)HTML formatting4 business hours8 hours7 days90%

Enhanced support

Enterprise customers can agree a custom support agreement case by case. Contact support@personalisationhub.com.
